title.zh: 将布基农省 Malaybalay 市 Kalasungay 描笼涯一所国立中学的附属校分离，改设为独立的 Kalasungay 国立中学，并为此拨款
title.en: An Act Separating the Bukidnon National High School - Kalasungay Annex in Barangay Kalasungay, City of Malaybalay, Province of Bukidnon From the Bukidnon National High School, Converting It into an Independent National High School to be Known as Kalasungay National High School and Appropriating Funds Therefor

title.vi: Đạo luật tách Phân hiệu Kalasungay của Trường Trung học Bukidnon Quốc gia tại Barangay Kalasungay, Thành phố Malaybalay, Tỉnh Bukidnon khỏi Trường Trung học Bukidnon Quốc gia và chuyển thành Trường Trung học Độc lập Quốc gia với tên gọi Trường Trung học Kalasungay Quốc gia, và bố trí kinh phí
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติแยกวิทยาเขต Kalasungay ของโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Bukidnon แห่งชาติในบารังไกย์ Kalasungay เมือง Malaybalay จังหวัด Bukidnon ออกจากโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Bukidnon แห่งชาติและยกฐานะเป็นโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาเอกเทศแห่งชาติชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Kalasungay แห่งชาติ และจัดสรรงบประมาณ
title.id: Undang-Undang Memisahkan Kampus Kalasungay, Sekolah Menengah Bukidnon Nasional di Barangay Kalasungay, Kota Malaybalay, Provinsi Bukidnon dari Sekolah Menengah Bukidnon Nasional dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Mandiri Nasional dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Kalasungay Nasional, dan mengalokasikan dana
title.ms: Akta Memisahkan Kampus Kalasungay, Sekolah Menengah Bukidnon Kebangsaan di Barangay Kalasungay, Bandar Malaybalay, Wilayah Bukidnon daripada Sekolah Menengah Bukidnon Kebangsaan dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Bebas Kebangsaan dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Kalasungay Kebangsaan, dan memperuntukkan dana

text.en: Separation and Conversion into a National High School. — The Bukidnon National High School — Kalasungay Annex in Barangay Kalasungay, City of Malaybalay, Province of Bukidnon is hereby separated from the Bukidnon National High School and converted into an independent national high school to be known as Kalasungay National High School.

Transfer of Assets and Liabilities. — All personnel, assets, liabilities and records of the Bukidnon National High School — Kalasungay Annex are hereby transferred to and absorbed by the Kalasungay National High School.

Appropriations. – The Secretary of Education shall immediately include in the Department’s program the operationalization of the Kalasungay National High School, the initial funding of which shall be charged against the current year’s appropriations of the Bukidnon National High School — Kalasungay Annex. Thereafter, the amount necessary for the continued operation of the school shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
Implementation. — The Secretary of Education shall issue such rules and regulations as may be necessary to carry out the purpose of this Act.
Effectivity. — This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette.
